decision: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
event_name: Date 12 May 2019 Time 14:01 2019 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 9 - 12 May 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Technical Delegate (document 33), have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 34.2 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
penalty: Required to start the race from the pit lane.
reason: The stewards reviewed the evidence from the Technical Delegate and determined that as the front brake map parameters are different from those originally used in qualifying the competitor is required to start from the pit lane.
